title: Billing, Minimum Payment and AutoPay Terms — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit
content:
These are the billing and payment terms of FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, by tier.

**1. Billing cycle.** On every tier the billing cycle closes 25 calendar days before the due date (Calendar days before the due date that the billing cycle closes).

**2. Draw-period minimum payment.**

| Tier | Minimum payment (% of the statement balance) | Lowest minimum payment (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| FlexLine Starter | 3.0 | 35.00 |
| FlexLine Standard | 3.0 | 35.00 |
| FlexLine Plus | 2.5 | 30.00 |
| FlexLine Preferred | 2.5 | 30.00 |
| FlexLine Premier | 2.0 | 25.00 |
| FlexLine Elite | 2.0 | 25.00 |

The percent column is the draw-period minimum payment: percent of the statement balance (plus interest and fees billed in the cycle). The lowest-payment column is the lowest minimum payment in the draw period, USD (or the whole balance if smaller).

*Hypothetical worked figure:* on a FlexLine Plus statement balance of 2000.00 USD, 2.5% is 50.00 USD, above the 30.00 USD lowest payment; on a balance of 900.00 USD, 2.5% is 22.50 USD, so the 30.00 USD lowest payment holds; on a balance of 18.00 USD the whole balance of 18.00 USD is smaller than 30.00 USD.

**3. Payment once the line is in repayment.** On every tier: level payment amortizing the balance at the start of repayment over the repayment period at the APR in force, recalculated when the APR changes.

**4. Payment allocation order.** On every tier a payment is applied to billed interest, then fees, then the remaining balance.

**5. AutoPay amounts.** On every tier AutoPay can debit, on each due date, the minimum payment, the statement balance or a fixed amount (Amounts AutoPay can debit on each due date).

**6. Due-day changes.** On every tier the due day may be changed 1 time per line in any rolling 12 months (Due-day changes allowed per line in any rolling 12 months (integer)).
